turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I take the subway about four times a week. Should I get a monthly pass?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: At four trips a week, it's close. Do you also use it on weekends, or would you mostly pay per ride outside of work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, which one did you like better, the blue one or the grey one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The grey one drove nicer. The blue one felt kind of heavy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But the blue one has a bigger boot. We need space for the dog.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: True. The dog doesn't care how it drives.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we go back and test drive them again tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Let's do it in the morning, before the dealership gets busy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. I'll call them first thing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. I was asking about your weekend trips.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I go out most weekends.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then the monthly pass is worth it. Every weekend ride is basically free.
